data.exact_reserve_text: The net claims ratio, which includes the impact of movements in the Long-Term Business Provision increased by 2% to 60% for the 2018 calendar year driven by a number of high value claims on a particular binder on the 2017 year of account in the earlier part of the year. In addition, following the decision to cease underwriting, a run-off provision is included within the reserves of the Syndicate. The Syndicate entered into a reinsurance to close transaction with Syndicate 779 covering all of the open years of account of Syndicate 779 (2014, 2015 and 2016) resulting in the cessation of the Syndicate. A premium of GBP 14.8m is receivable, representing the net technical provisions reinsured.

prior_year_events.event_name: High value claims on a particular binder
prior_year_events.impact_description: adverse development on a particular binder on the 2017 year of account, contributing to an increase in the net claims ratio.

Syndicate 44 accepted the liabilities of Syndicate 779 for its 2014, 2015, and 2016 years of account, with a premium of GBP 14.8m receivable. The claims development triangle shows releases or no change for these years after the RITC.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an overall gross reserve release of GBP 1.178 million for prior underwriting years up to 2016, calculated from the claims development triangle. This includes releases for the 2016 and 2015 underwriting years, and a small strengthening for 2013. The syndicate also accepted a reinsurance to close from Syndicate 779 for its 2014, 2015, and 2016 years of account, which would have impacted the reserves for those years. Separately, the net claims ratio increased due to adverse development from high value claims on a particular binder in the 2017 year of account.

data.data_quality_notes: The gross claims development triangle may be affected by the acceptance of a reinsurance to close from Syndicate 779 for the 2014, 2015, and 2016 underwriting years, which could distort the apparent movements for those years. The calculated prior year development from the triangle excludes the 2017 underwriting year, for which the narrative indicates adverse development.
